docs: Update subnet listing status (freeze/unfreeze)
Can only be called by the contract owner
messages.label: set_subnet_listing_status

docs: List Alpha tokens for sale with dynamic market-relative pricing
Prerequisites: The seller must have added the contract as their proxy
This will transfer the stake from the seller to the contract via proxy
and consolidate it under the contract's hotkey if needed
price_offset_bps: Price offset from market in basis points (-500 = -5%, 1000 = +10%)
messages.label: list_alpha

docs: Cancel an Alpha listing and return the stake to the seller
Can only be called by the listing owner after minimum age has passed
messages.label: cancel_alpha_listing

docs: Force-cancel an Alpha listing as the contract owner
messages.label: force_cancel_alpha_listing

docs: Get a specific Alpha listing
messages.label: get_listing

docs: Get all listing IDs for a user on a specific subnet
messages.label: get_user_listings

docs: Create a TAO offer by depositing TAO into the contract with dynamic market-relative pricing
The buyer sends TAO with the transaction and specifies their price offset from market
price_offset_bps: Price offset from market in basis points (-500 = -5%, 1000 = +10%)
messages.label: create_tao_offer

docs: Cancel a TAO offer and return the TAO to the buyer
Can only be called by the offer owner
messages.label: cancel_tao_offer

docs: Get a specific TAO offer
messages.label: get_offer

docs: Get all offer IDs for a user on a specific subnet
messages.label: get_user_offers

docs: Estimate the price for taking an Alpha listing at current market price
Returns: (executed_price * 1e9, tao_amount, total_with_fee)
messages.label: estimate_listing_price

docs: Estimate the Alpha amount needed to take a TAO offer at current market price
Returns: (executed_price * 1e9, alpha_amount_needed, tao_for_seller)
messages.label: estimate_offer_price

docs: Take an Alpha listing by paying TAO with dynamic market-relative pricing
The buyer sends TAO with the transaction to purchase Alpha tokens
Price is calculated based on current market price + listing's price offset
Allows overpayment and refunds excess TAO to buyer
messages.label: take_alpha_listing

docs: Claim staking rewards accumulated by the contract for a subnet
Only callable by the contract owner while the contract is not fully paused
messages.label: claim_dividends

docs: Take a TAO offer by providing Alpha tokens with dynamic market-relative pricing
The seller provides Alpha tokens to claim the TAO at the market price + offer's offset
Prerequisites: The seller must have added the contract as their proxy
messages.label: take_tao_offer

docs: Replace contract code with new implementation
Only callable by contract owner
messages.label: set_code

docs: Pause trading operations (no new trades, but cancellations allowed)
Only callable by contract owner
messages.label: pause_trading

docs: Fully pause the contract (no operations except admin functions)
Only callable by contract owner
messages.label: pause_fully

docs: Resume normal contract operations
Only callable by contract owner
messages.label: resume

docs: Get the current pause state
messages.label: get_pause_state
